errors.text_span: 以0.1为间隔划分了多个区间
errors.evidence: The description states that the intervals (bins) on the x-axis have a width of 0.1. However, the visible tick marks are at intervals of 0.2 (0.2, 0.4, 0.6, etc.), and by counting the bars between ticks (e.g., 4 bars between 0.2 and 0.4), the actual bin width is approximately 0.05.
The tallest bar is just above the 1750 tick mark. A value of 1800 is a slight overestimation; it appears closer to 1825 or 1850.
